source.worktree_note: The repository has unrelated uncommitted rescue changes. All audited skill, evidence MCP, evidence binding, and cited test paths are clean against HEAD.

decision_meanings.already_present: The fifth-version checkout already contains the capability or an official pinned replacement; do not copy the V4 package.
decision_meanings.adopt_on_demand: Candidate for selective Lead Agent loading after package review and a task-specific evaluation; never preload the whole set.
decision_meanings.distill_method: Extract reviewed, source-backed judgment lenses into the incubation method library; do not activate the V4 workflow package.
decision_meanings.rewrite_adapter: Preserve the capability contract and reliability lessons, but implement a thin fifth-version adapter against current tools and schemas.
decision_meanings.exclude: Do not migrate into the fifth-version product because it is a retired orchestrator, out-of-scope film system, duplicate runtime, or unsafe fit.

skills.name: personal-ip-operator

skills.reason: Its purified judgment lenses are valuable and are already partly represented by sourced V5 method cards; the full package must not become a second strategy owner.
